businesses.business: financial services and healthcare software and outsourcing

offering_description.value: Provides software and software-enabled outsourcing services to financial services and healthcare firms. Customers include asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, banks, insurers and wealth managers. Delivered via cloud platforms, hosted software and fund administration and transfer agency services.

primary_products.value: portfolio management and accounting software; trading and treasury software; investor and wealth management platforms; loan and insurance software; healthcare claims software

primary_services.value: fund administration; transfer agency and investor servicing; software-enabled outsourcing; business process outsourcing; managed hosting

customer_segment.value: B2B: asset managers, hedge funds, private equity, banks, insurers, wealth managers, healthcare payers and corporations

end_markets.value: asset management; alternative investments; banking; insurance; healthcare; real estate

revenue_model.value: subscription: software-as-a-service and hosted software subscriptions; service fees: fund administration and outsourcing fees, often asset-based; licensing or royalties: software licenses and maintenance
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts financial and healthcare software sold to institutions; service provider: performs fund administration and outsourced operations for financial firms

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: financial services software, fund administration outsourcing and healthcare software sharing institutional customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to financial institutions and healthcare organizations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data security and privacy rules, plus SEC, FINRA and other financial regulations on transfer agency and fund administration, HIPAA for healthcare
